98168ad381.about: Moon Child is Cork's first mobile matcha bar. Founder Monica Steenkamp, a South African barista who has lived in Cork for nearly seven years, fell for matcha in 2021 while working at The Grumpy Bakers café and began crafting her own flavour syrups. Moon Child started in 2025 as a pop-up at Cork farmers' markets and opened its first bricks-and-mortar spot, a pink "matcha hideout" upstairs at the former Cork Lotus Yoga studio reception on Carey's Lane, on 21 February 2026. Monica calls it an "extended pop-up" and says more days and hours will be added if it does well.
